plan.title: SOTA Agentic OS (AQ-OS), Co-Evolving System 1 Models & Verified Software Factory
plan.goal: Establish and prove SOTA leadership across the Agentic Operating System (AQ-OS), Co-Evolving Local System 1 Models, Deterministic Compiler/Verifier Phalanx, and Multi-Model Collaborative Environment (Simurg) on a basic laptop + pooled subscriptions, multiplied by open-source reciprocity.

items.name: S1 - aq-context-packet v0 (NEW)
items.goal: Deterministic <=2,500-token context packet for local models (AST signatures, optional graph callers).

items.name: S2 - aq-land runs tier0 on touched scope before review
items.goal: Local compiler/test wall before cross-family review.
items.validation_goal: aq-land refuses review dispatch on failing tier0.

items.name: S3 - delegate-to-local power/thermal gate
items.goal: Defer local jobs unless AC or battery>=50%, load5 hysteresis (0.70/0.55 x ncpu), CPU temp<80C; unreadable sensor = defer, never drop.
items.validation_goal: Tests cover each gate input and hysteresis.

items.name: S4 - receipt JSONL + aq-scoreboard (NEW)
items.goal: Append-only receipts with real token counts, post-redaction scan-or-quarantine, aq-scoreboard CLI with raw counts.
items.validation_goal: Tests cover append-only, quarantine, scoreboard counts.
